govWatch.line: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Night Court is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
📺 Amélia killed Night Court out past the ridge — alone — and walked home. 6 rounds, 54 taken. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
🌾 Tribute from Stonebridge arrives — 3,000 kcal of grain into the pantry. Their fields, our fire.
🌾 Tribute from Stonebridge arrives — 1,688 kcal of grain into the pantry. Their fields, our fire.

lines.text: "Every laugh out there feels wrong today. Then I feel wrong for thinking it."
"Walk my trap line with me? Extra hands, extra eyes."
"All right — let's ask them." You carry the proposal to Stonebridge.
